# mg3x-protobuild

Original synthetic code written for this repository. It contains no third-party code or assets and is released under the repository license. `Protobuild.exe` is an ASCII placeholder, not a program. It is never executed.

## Purpose

A MonoGame repository that keeps its projects in Protobuild definitions and has no generated `.csproj`. It shows the "Protobuild only" case: the tool must explain that the project files have to be generated first.

## Positive for

MG010.
